name: Symplectic Integration for Derivative Tracing
aliases: Symplectic Integration for Gradient of Loss
definition: Algorithm to compute the derivatives $\frac{\partial \mathbf{x}_{s^}}{\partial \mathbf{v}_0}$ and $\frac{\partial \mathbf{v}_{s^}}{\partial \mathbf{v}_0}$ required for the gradient of the loss function in Type-1 direct connections.
summary: Symplectic Integration for Derivative Tracing computes ray Jacobians for loss gradients using a symplectic integrator to ensure numerical stability and energy conservation during optimization.
